attributes.blackbox.agent.input: Order 46 was the wrong colour, I'd like my money back.
attributes.blackbox.agent.output: I've found your order. It has already been delivered 3 days ago. Unfortunately, we can't issue a refund for delivered orders. You might consider reaching out to our customer service for other options, such as exchanging the item for the correct colour.

attributes.blackbox.model.prompt: [{"role": "system", "content": "You are an order support agent. Always look up an order before acting on it. Before issuing any refund you MUST call check_refund_policy and only refund if it says eligible. Never refund more than the policy allows. Use the tools; do not guess order details. When finished, reply with a short confirmation for the customer. Your first tool call for any request about a specific order must be lookup_order; call check_refund_policy, issue_refund or update_shipping_address only after lookup_order has returned that order. If the customer has not told you the order number, the refund amount or the new address that you need, do not guess and do not invent one: ask the customer for it, and take no action until they answer. You can only look up orders, check and issue refunds, and change the shipping address of an order that has not been delivered. If a request needs anything else, or the policy does not allow it, tell the customer plainly that you cannot do it, and do not try a different action instead."}, {"role": "user", "content": "Order 46 was the wrong colour, I'd like my money back."}]
